text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—A Triple Crown Umamusume is born! The 
Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho... The name of the girl who 
conquered every single race is...!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur! Air Shakur etches her name 
into history as a Triple Crown 
Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A Triple Crown Umamusume...
(Waaaaaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... So this is the power of a 
Triple Crown...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If mere 'feelings' could change anything, 
things would've flipped around ages ago!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Maybe I should just quit everything... 
*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If I had known, I wouldn't have said 
that, even as a lie.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Is *this* how it felt?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"A Triple Crown Umamusume, huh... Me, of 
all people..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Doesn't suit me for shit. ...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh... Haha! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
She's laughing triumphantly... Is she... 
ha... happy...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... but man, what do we do 
about the interview...? She's a Triple 
Crown Umamusume, you know? We definitely 
want a comment, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, me, a Triple Crown 
Umamusume...? Haha, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Reporters A & B
text_block_list.text: —It's hard to go there...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The Triple Crown... Heheheh...!

Once the post-race hustle and bustle 
settled down, Air Shakur completely 
switched his mindset back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
With this, we can finally finalize our 
Senior Class race rotation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Without changing our goals, we'll focus on 
the Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Takarazuka 
Kinen. Just those two races for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'll take the path shown by 
"Parcae"— the "best" one... even if, 
looking at the outcome alone, it's the 
absolute worst route.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, what we're challenging is 
the absolute best rotation possible in 
this country right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If destiny has changed, the outcome should 
change too. I'll have to recalculate the 
theoretical values.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Senior-class runners will be in the next 
Japan Cup too. It'll make for a good 
benchmark.

The Japan Cup— With international 
Umamusume sometimes invited, it's a GⅠ 
race that draws immense attention. 
However—
choice_data_list: What place did "Parcae" predict you'd get?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: 14th place. A complete and utter defeat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Until now, that's how it was supposed to 
be. That was the destiny meant to unfold.
choice_data_list:
Still, if that's changed, then that 
means...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"There's a reason I can't be that 
optimistic. Why the hell did 'Parcae' 
judge that we'd suffer a crushing defeat 
in the first place...?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I told you, didn't I? We're taking on the 
ultimate rotation.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the competition will be 
monster-tier, too. Especially *this* 
year... Well, more on that later.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
While she rests, I will adjust the 
training menu based on the recalculated 
figures.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Once it unfolds, check it immediately.

Just as the conversation ended and we were 
about to disperse... voices could be heard 
from a nearby table.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
"—Ah, the Kikuka Sho was so exciting too! 
A Triple Crown Umamusume has finally 
emerged, huh."

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur was that good, huh? I was so 
distracted by her flashy look that I had 
no idea.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
More importantly! What about the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) coming up? Do you think Opera O's 
gonna win after all?

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Right! She's seriously way too strong! We 
definitely gotta secure a good spot to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...What're you doing? Aren't you heading 
home?
choice_data_list: I'll clean this up and be right over!

text_block_list.text:
The topic of the Kikuka-sho quickly passed 
by. For some reason, such a trivial detail 
lingered in my mind...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(However... where did my fate change? My 
debut race... No, that's not it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(If that's the case, it must have started 
before then. Something unplanned at that 
stage... Ever since forming a contract 
with that guy... ?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You waltz right in! Acting like some 
savior!! What the hell... can you even 
do...?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah... so she really was our savior, huh? 
Not funny in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, maybe it was just... 
impossible for me alone.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(It's like this whole drama was scripted 
from the start, and my own will never 
mattered one damn bit... I'm even startin' 
to have crazy delusions like that.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever. We've made it this far... It 
doesn't matter if the whole thing's a 
farce.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Next year will be my era. Even if no one 
wants it to be.

Back home and all by myself, I was 
reflecting on Air Shakur's running today.

Immense spirit, razor-sharp speed, 
brilliant radiance... And above all, that 
relentless obsession with victory.

I thought it would be enough just to see 
her overcome her fate and achieve victory. 
But now, I find myself wanting more.
choice_data_list:
(I want as many people as possible to know 
about her.)

text_block_list.text:
"Not just for the audience of this era. 
But for the people of the distant future 
who know nothing of racing. I want them to 
know her, to love her. And..."
choice_data_list: (I want you to leave your name behind—)

text_block_list.text: —Such a desire had begun to sprout.
